claim_boundary.supports: Reviewed scope: Nat values a and b satisfy (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a + b * b + 2 * (a * b). When both are positive, 2 * (a * b) > 0 and a * a + b * b < (a + b) * (a + b). When the left input is 0, 2 * (0 * b) = 0 and (0 + b) * (0 + b) = b * b. When the right input is 0, 2 * (a * 0) = 0 and (a + 0) * (a + 0) = a * a. Nat values a and b satisfy (a + b) * (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a * a + b * b * b + 3 * a * b * (a + b). A disjoint Nat pair satisfies (x + 0) * (x + 0) + (0 + y) * (0 + y) = x * x + y * y.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: Reviewed scope: Nat values a and b satisfy (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a + b * b + 2 * (a * b). When both are positive, 2 * (a * b) > 0 and a * a + b * b < (a + b) * (a + b). When the left input is 0, 2 * (0 * b) = 0 and (0 + b) * (0 + b) = b * b. When the right input is 0, 2 * (a * 0) = 0 and (a + 0) * (a + 0) = a * a. Nat values a and b satisfy (a + b) * (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a * a + b * b * b + 3 * a * b * (a + b). A disjoint Nat pair satisfies (x + 0) * (x + 0) + (0 + y) * (0 + y) = x * x + y * y.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Real exponent p>1, a Minkowski comparison on real vectors, strict convexity, roots, and transport past this Nat square, cubic, and one disjoint pair stay outside the standing text. A zero input is an equality case of the square expansion.
